findings: Preserved the original 2023-01-17 publication date, removed conflicting injected date metadata, and set lastmod to 2026-11-23 in all editions.
Replaced the cross-origin embedded Sponsor iframe with a direct, accessible GitHub Sponsors profile link in every locale.
Clarified that support is voluntary, intended for tool development/maintenance and related project costs, and that code signing is an aspiration without a promised feature or date.
Linked GitHub’s current fees/tax policy and directed sponsors to check currently available tiers and benefits on the profile.
scope: Read the full Japanese sponsorship notice and all twelve translations. Checked the public Sponsor profile, payment/tax statements, link targets, embedded content, and translated intent against current GitHub primary documentation.

meaning.note: Read the complete Japanese article and complete localized edition. Compared the voluntary sponsorship request, intended support for tool development/maintenance, code-signing certificate as an aspiration only, and the direct profile call to action.

terminology.note: Checked localized terms for GitHub Sponsors, independent developer, voluntary support, currently displayed tiers/benefits, billing and tax treatment.

mathematics.note: The article contains no mathematical content or quantitative performance claims.

code.note: The article contains no code or executable embed; the prior cross-origin iframe was removed in favor of a direct accessible profile link.

links.note: Verified that the public GitHub Sponsors profile is available and checked GitHub’s official fees/tax documentation and profile-sharing guidance.
